stem:
Chlorine, $\text{Cl}_2$, reacts with many elements and compounds to form chlorides.

Table 2.1 shows information about some chlorides of Period 3 elements.

Table 2.1

|  | Na | Mg | Si |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| formula of chloride |  |  |  |
| structure of chloride | giant |  |  |
| bonding of chloride |  |  | covalent |
| pH of solution formed on addition of chloride to water |  | 6.2 |  |

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: When $\text{Cl}_2$ reacts with **cold** $\text{NaOH(aq)}$, $\text{Cl}_2$ is both oxidised and reduced. The products are $\text{NaCl}$, water and **G**.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: State the type of redox reaction in which the same species is both oxidised and reduced.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Write an equation for the reaction between $\text{Cl}_2$ and **hot** $\text{NaOH(aq)}$.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text: Describe fully what is observed when $\text{AgNO}_3\text{(aq)}$ is added to the aqueous solution of the chloride of sodium, followed by dilute $\text{NH}_3\text{(aq)}$.

parts.label: (c)
parts.stem: An excess of $\text{Cl}_2$ reacts with phosphorus to form $\text{PCl}_5$.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text:
$\text{PCl}_5$ is a simple molecule in the gas phase.

It also exists in a solid form as two ions, $\text{PCl}_4{}^+$ and $\text{PCl}_6{}^-$.

Complete Table 2.2 to identify the shapes of each of these species.

Table 2.2

| species | $\text{PCl}_5$ | $\text{PCl}_4{}^+$ | $\text{PCl}_6{}^-$ |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| shape |  | tetrahedral |  |

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text:
$\text{PCl}_5$ reacts with **J** to form $\text{H}_3\text{PO}_4$.

Identify **J** and state the type of reaction.

parts.label: (d)
parts.stem:
$\text{Cl}_2$ reacts readily with propene to form **K**, 1,2-dichloropropane.

**K** can be used to form **L**.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.text:
Complete Fig. 2.2 to show the mechanism for the reaction of $\text{Cl}_2$ with propene in reaction 1.

Include charges, dipoles, lone pairs of electrons and curly arrows, as appropriate.

Fig. 2.2

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text: Identify the reagent and conditions for reaction 2.

parts.label: (d)(iii)
parts.text: Draw **one** repeat unit of the addition polymer that forms from **L**.
